metadata.title: What if Levi's cleaning day became a survival drill?
metadata.description:
Levi converts an apparently petty cleaning inspection into practical equipment checks and team safety training.

Original hypothetical comedy and commentary. Fan-made alternate scenario; events and dialogue are invented, not canon. AI-assisted narration: Kokoro am_michael. Sound effects: Brackeys, public domain.

#Shorts #Anime #WhatIf #AttackOnTitan
